limitations: CPU/native component wall time; excludes host capture, source shading header, GPU upload/render/shadows and actual game FPS
Separate JVM warm runs, not simultaneous live-game A/B, no customer hardware measurements
Rigid group patches are temporary diagnostic assets; coupled joints mean marginal cost is not additive
Quality geometry sampled every six updates, finite/inversion checks every update
Default base-PMX alpha stream inventory; excludes Native original draw expansion, outline/fringe duplication
Prototype maximum Newton iterations and tolerance changed together; isolated tolerance tests showed no measurable win
